The '''Imperial Investigation Committee on Lepusan Intelligence''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] organization convened to rule on the intelligence level of the [[lepusa]], a creature native to the [[Freliq]].<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
